messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: Authentication: JWT verification failures spike > 90% across prod regions. Service: auth-service. Severity: P0. Pager: on-call (Alice Mendez).
PagerDuty: Incident created (INC1887654321) — paging Alice Mendez.
Alice Mendez: acked on-call pager. looking now.
Alice Mendez: quick check — logs show `token_verifier` throwing `kid mismatch` on public key lookup from JWKS endpoint.
Bob Singh: @Alice any chance this is a key rotation we missed? Which JWKS URL is auth-service using?
Alice Mendez: it's hitting https://keys.prod.redwood-inference.com/.well-known/jwks.json — responses started returning a new keyset with no matching `kid` for recent tokens.
Carla Ruiz: I'm seeing traffic errors from both north-virginia and europe-west regions. failures -> 503 downstream to jwks cache layer around 12:42:10Z.
Dan Park: paging infra — @Dan Park can you confirm JWKS edge cache health?
Dan Park: jumped into the edge caches — control plane rolled a config earlier (deploy at 12:40) that changed cache TTLs. nodes started fetching new JWKS and got an empty response for ~30s from origin due to throttling.
Dan Park: sending `kubectl get pods -n infra jwks-cache -o wide` now.
infra-deploy-bot: rollout detected: infra/jwks-cache 2026-02-28T12:39:58Z by deploy-batch-17.
Alice Mendez: mitigation idea: temporarily allow fallback to last-known-good JWKS from local cache so tokens signed under old kid validate. Can we flip that at the auth-service config?
Bob Singh: +1. Also we should short-circuit strict kid check for 2 minutes while we stabilize (audit-only mode). I'll prepare a small patch.
Carla Ruiz: customer impact: login and token exchange failing, API 401s for most customers. Support already getting tickets.
Erin Zhao: Support here. Customer-facing note: "We're investigating an authentication disruption affecting logins. We're operating mitigation steps and will update in 15 minutes." I'll post to status.redwood.com once we have a rollback or mitigation.
Alice Mendez: applying hotfix: set AUTH_JWKS_FALLBACK=true in auth-service config and increase local cache TTL. Pushing prod config change now.
infra-deploy-bot: configmap update applied: auth-config (namespace=prod) by Alice Mendez at 12:46:05Z.
Alice Mendez: restarting auth-service pods to pick up config: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-service -n prod`
infra-deploy-bot: restart started for deployment/auth-service (8 pods).
Carla Ruiz: watching tokentrace — error rate dropping to 20% in eu-west, 25% in us-east.
Bob Singh: I shipped the short-circuit patch to validation lib and bumped canary to 10% traffic before full rollout.
infra-deploy-bot: canary rollout: auth-service v2.3.1-canary -> 10% traffic at 12:51:12Z.
Alice Mendez: acking progress. still monitoring KV caches and JWKS origin.
Dan Park: origin JWKS service was throttling due to an autoscaler race — fixed scaling rule, origin returns full set and includes expected kid now.
Carla Ruiz: token verification errors under 2% across regions. Seems stable.
Erin Zhao: posted status update: "Mitigation applied; authentication errors significantly reduced. We're monitoring and will follow up with full postmortem."
Alice Mendez: handing off to oncall for next shift — @Bob Singh you're up for incident management watches for next hour?
Bob Singh: taking handoff. I'll keep a live watch, coordinate with infra to validate no regression for 2 more hours.
Alice Mendez: notes to postmortem: root cause = JWKS origin throttling after infra config change decreased readiness during deploy -> caused origin to return incomplete keyset; auth-service had strict kid enforcement and empty cache TTLs so new tokens couldn't be validated. Mitigation = enable local fallback cache + short-circuit kid check + fix origin autoscaling and restore previous TTLs.
Carla Ruiz: collecting logs and sampling affected token `kid`s for postmortem.
Erin Zhao: customers notified, support triage queue created.
Bob Singh: closing incident pager (INC1887654321) to standby; will open follow-up postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:
